name: design-code
summary: Emit production code for a named stack, with tokens, states, a11y and dark mode already in it.

when: code is wanted for React, Next, SwiftUI, or any other target
an adapter is needed for a framework with no dedicated file
not: deciding what the component should be

steps: For a target with no dedicated file, read the adapter protocol and generate the adapter first.
Tokens, never literals. Every interactive element carries its ARIA. Every state is handled. Dark mode comes from semantic tokens, not a second stylesheet.
Deliver COMPLETE files. A placeholder comment standing in for unchanged code is a broken output. Asked for N components, deliver N.
output: Copy-paste-ready typed code, complete files only.
done: lint_hardcodes finds no raw hex/px/timing outside adapter config
no file contains an elision standing in for real code
the count delivered equals the count asked for
